record.title: One Piece
record.description:
From Viz:  
As a child, Monkey D. Luffy was inspired to become a pirate by listening to the tales of "Red-Haired" Shanks. But his life changed when Luffy accidentally ate the Gum-Gum Devil Fruit and gained the power to stretch like rubber at the cost of never being able to swim again. Years later, still vowing to become the king of the pirates, Luffy sets out on his adventure one guy alone in a rowboat, in search of the legendary "One Piece," said to be the greatest treasure in the world.

The best-selling manga in history and tied with Superman for the best-selling comics in history.

**Official Japanese:**  
[Jump Comics](https://www.shueisha.co.jp/books/items/contents.html?isbn=4-08-872509-3), [Jump Comics DIGITAL](https://www.s-manga.net/items/contents.html?jdcn=08872509872509315501), [Shonen Jump Plus](https://shonenjumpplus.com/episode/10833519556325021794), [Yangjiang+](https://ynjn.jp/comicList/1619), [Zebrack](https://zebrack-comic.shueisha.co.jp/title/59/volume/1716)

**Official Translations:**  
Read for FREE on Manga Plus ([English](https://mangaplus.shueisha.co.jp/titles/100020), [French](https://mangaplus.shueisha.co.jp/titles/700005), [German](https://mangaplus.shueisha.co.jp/titles/800001), [Indonesian](https://mangaplus.shueisha.co.jp/titles/100140), [Portugese](https://mangaplus.shueisha.co.jp/titles/100149), [Spanish](https://mangaplus.shueisha.co.jp/titles/200016), [Thai](https://mangaplus.shueisha.co.jp/titles/100079), [Vietnamese](https://mangaplus.shueisha.co.jp/titles/1000001))     

[English](https://www.viz.com/manga-books/one-piece/series/5/section/62123/more), [French](https://www.ono.live/manga/one-piece-chapitres), Korean ([Kakao Page](https://page.kakao.com/content/46347471), [Manyeo Comics](https://www.mcomics.co.kr/cartoon/9688?from=cartoon), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/dcwcm_0121), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=2549781), [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/1019015746))

Note: Nominated for the Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize from 2000 to 2002. Won the Sondermann audience award at the Frankfurt Book Fair Comics Centre in 2005, 2008 and 2009. Won the 41st Japan Cartoonists Association Award Grand Prize alongside [Neko Darake](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=48911469395) in 2012. Received the Kumamoto Prefecture Honorary Prize in 2018

record.title: One Piece Party
record.description: Spin-off of One Piece, which takes place post-timeskip, showing the cast in SD/chibi form and features their hilarious antics around various islands while out in the sea.

record.title: Koisuru One Piece
record.description: The premise of this gag manga is about three high school students: a young male student, his girlfriend and a third wheel who is a One Piece fanatic. Their names are similar to the Straw Hat Pirates and the group form a fan club dedicated to One Piece.

record.title: One Piece Gakuen
record.description:
Koby is a teenager who has recently transferred to the New World Academy. Fed up with his former upperclassman Alvida's dealings, Koby is willing to make one hundred friends at his new school. It is not long until he meets a boy made of rubber named Monkey D. Luffy, with whom he becomes inseparable in a matter of minutes.

Under the guidance of their apathetic teacher, Koby and Luffy are bound to have eventful lives and interact with their eccentric classmates. During their everyday adventures at the academy, they face the seven most powerful students in the school, the Shichibukai, and defy the rules imposed by the student council headed by the teachers' lackey, Rob Lucci.

record.title: Boku no One Piece
record.description:
*Boku no One Piece* begins with the main character, Hitoshi Hitotonoya, dressed in a beautiful dress on his way to the funeral of a certain person. He proudly wears women's clothing, but behind it all is his friend from college, Masato Sawara... This work depicts the story of a man who is troubled by his gender and a man who shines a light on it.

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated via DeepL)

record.title: One Piece Film: Gold
record.description: Made out of full-color illustrated stills from the 2016 film.

record.title: One Piece Color Walk
record.description:
From Viz:  
This first volume covers the early parts of the series from the East Blue arc where the main characters of the Straw Hat pirates first meet, to the Skypiea arc where Luffy and friends face their greatest adventures yet.

record.title: Kenkoukotsu to One Piece
record.description:
He wants to see those innocent eyes fill with desire. He wants to be handled roughly by those young hands. He wants to get intimate... though he knows he has no right to wish for anything like that. Mr. Futaba is a crossdresser who loves things that are cute and pretty. Because of this secret, he's given up on looking for glorious relationships, believing that he has no right to be happy and has been living quietly as a teacher of classic literature. But Hikaru, a handsome high school student he teaches who is exactly his type, seems interested in him... A little dark and with a lot of tenderness, this is a story about love and life featuring a high school boy who's gone from a good little Samaritan to a radiant Prince Charming and an introverted teacher who likes to dress like a woman.

[English release on Renta](https://www.ebookrenta.com/renta/sc/frm/item/141786/)

record.title: One Piece (Databook)
record.description:
1) One Piece Red: Grand Characters - Collects Romance Dawn Version 1: The original one-shot that led to One Piece. There are 3 versions of Romance Dawn: This one was written first, the second version is featured in [Wanted!](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=14853239448) and the last is the first chapter of [One Piece](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=55099564912).

2) One Piece Blue: Grand Data File  
3) One Piece Yellow: Grand Elements   
4) One Piece Green: Secret Pieces  
5) One Piece Blue Deep: Characters World - Collects Chapter 0: The prequel to the movie One Piece: Strong World.

Continued as: *Vivre Card - One Piece Visual Dictionary*

record.title: Luff
record.description: Special Episode "Luff" is a three chapter "what if" storyline showing what would happen if Sabo had rescued Luffy and Ace at Marineford. It ran in the first three volumes of the official One Piece magazine.

record.title: One Piece Cover Comic Project
record.description:
One Piece's chapters redrawn by Shueisha's mangaka.

1) Roronoa Zoro Falls Into the Sea, by Boichi (2019, Shuukan Shounen Jump)  
Based on chapters 51 and 52.  
2) Vivi's Adventure, by KOMI Naoshi (2021, Shuukan Shounen Jump)  
Based on chapters 215 and 216.  
3) Nami vs. Kalifa, by Boichi (2022, One Piece Magazine)  
Based on chapters 410 to 412.

Note: Chapters 1 and 3 are collected in [One Piece Episode A](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=23499427437).

record.title: One Piece Straw Hat Theater
record.description: A series of 3-page omake strips. Their stories tend to parody other genres such as science fiction or fairy tales. Most were published as bonus content in the One Piece Complete Collection between the 2nd Log (2005) and the 20th Log (2012). All 13 chapters were digitally collected in 2020 as One Piece Straw Hat Grand Theater.

results.hit_title: ONE PIECE 麦わら大劇場

record.title: Cross Epoch
record.description: Cross Epoch is a one-shot Japanese manga collaboration by Akira Toriyama and Eiichiro Oda. It is a crossover between their respective manga Dragon Ball and One Piece.

record.title: One Piece Episode A
record.description:
From Viz:  
Experience the origin story of Fire Fist Ace, the legendary older brother of Straw Hat Luffy, in this exciting manga by renowned artist Boichi! Adventure along with Ace as he gathers a ragtag crew of like-minded buccaneers, including Masked Deuce, Mihal, Skull, and the wild Kotatsu, and forms the Spade Pirates. Witness the power of the Devil Fruit as it bestows Fire Fist’s fearsome punching power. Piratical feats abound as Ace and his Spade Pirates head toward the New World and the dreaded Captain Whitebeard.

Based on both volumes of [One Piece novel A (Novel)](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=19206830993). The manga has differences and omitted characters but features an original epilogue. 

Including Boichi´s one-shots from the [One Piece Cover Comic Project](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=50425009910):  
1) Roronoa Zoro Falls Into the Sea (Based on Chap 51-52)  
2) Nami vs. Kalifa (Based on Chap 410-412)

[Webcomic on Shonen Jump+](https://shonenjumpplus.com/episode/13933686331709463898)

record.title: Wanted!
record.description:
From Viz:  
See another version of Luffy in the original short story that launched a legend. The creator of One Piece presents this unique collection of his earliest works. From Western to fantasy to ghost story, this special volume has it al. Including “Romance Dawn,” the one-shot that would become the international megahit One Piece.

Included are:  
1) Wanted!  
2) God's Gift For The Future  
3) Ikki Yako  
4) Monsters   
Canon to One Piece introducing Shimotsuki Ryuma.   
5) Romance Dawn Version 2  
The second of two One Piece pilots.

results.hit_title: Wanted! Eiichiro Oda Before One Piece

record.title: One Piece x Toriko
record.description: A crossover between One Piece and Toriko.

record.title: Fischer's x One Piece
record.description: One Piece crossover with the YouTuber group Fischer's.

record.title: One Piece Novel Heroines (Novel)
record.description:
From Viz:  
Go behind the runway as style icon Nami stars in a life-changing fashion show, observe wise Robin as she helps to decipher an ancient tablet with Koala and Sabo, watch as solemn Princess Vivi receives a love letter from an unexpected admirer, and check out Ghost Princess Perona’s battle over the last bottle of wine with Zolo and Mihawk!

record.title: One Piece novel A (Novel)
record.description:
From Viz:  
Washed up on the shores of a deserted island at the edge of the East Blue Sea, two men from different backgrounds unite in their shared thirst for adventure. One of them, Portgaz D. Ace, will follow in his infamous father’s footsteps as the fearless captain of a pirate crew. The other, Masked Deuce, becomes the reluctant first member of Ace’s Spade Pirates. Survival is not enough for these seafaring buccaneers, as together they seek treasure, excitement, and a route to the New World.

record.title: One Piece novel Law (Novel)
record.description:
From Viz:  
Future Warlord of the Sea and fierce ally of Luffy’s Straw Hat Crew, young Trafalgar Law says farewell to his savior Corazon and starts his career as a surgeon and buccaneer! Along the way he meets an eccentric inventor named Wolf, Bepo the talking polar bear, and the mischievous orphans Shachi and Penguin. Follow along as the Heart Pirates begin their adventures together in this exciting novelization of Law’s youth!

Vol 1: One Piece novel Law  
Vol 2: One Piece novel Law: The Hour of Kikoku

record.title: Missing Piece
record.description:
Sawatari Ai is an insatiably curious high school student. One day, she notices that a boy named Akizuki Tooru has joined her class, but according to her friends, he's always been around! He was a childhood friend of hers, so why doesn't Ai remember him? But the weird thing is...Ai's memory lapse isn't the only weird thing. She's about to be faced with hyper psychic action!

Note: Volume 2 only has one chapter that deals with the main story; the rest of the volume consists of unrelated oneshots.

Dusk Is Twittering (Tasogare wa Sasayaku) - Is a school story about a boy--who draws--that transfers to a new school for follow a girl he has a crush on.  Unfortunately for him, she already has a boyfriend.

The Sound of Melting (Tokeru Koe) - Is school life story about a girl that dislikes her own voice due to being compared to her mother, who is a singer.  Despite this, she loves to sing.  So, there is a boy the sends her slips of a love letter after her voice lessons based on her voice.

Midsummer's Criminal (Natsu no Ran) - About an adult that tutors a 6th grader, who looks like an adult.

record.title: Green Peace
record.description:
From [Blissful Sin](http://www.mangaupdates.com/groups.html?id=1088):

Kosakabe Chihiro is enrolled as a first year in an agricultural high school. In this all boy’s school, Kosakabe treats his admirer, Kawana Ginji, like a slave. One day, Kawana suddenly steals Kosakabe’s first kiss! From then on, Kosakabe decides to skip morning duties. With a pale face, Kawana throws him into the storage room and then…! The real Kawana is actually…?

record.title: Shokugeki no Sanji
record.description: From the creators of Shokugeki no Soma, comes the  tales of  Sanji and his cooking adventures in the world of One Piece.

record.title: Lost Piece
record.description:
Haruya is a university student who's eager to get a girlfriend and he is one of those so-called "people who can see". While he was looking for a part-time job for his summer holidays, he met Kyouji, a doctor who's very interested in ghosts. Then after a strange turn of events, Haruya started working at the clinic that Kyouji runs.

To Haruya, Kyouji gives off the aura of someone who can't be left alone and for some reason there's always the ghost of a small child near him. Haruya continued to work while having these strange feelings and just when he had started getting used to his work, a (ghost) lady who fell in love with Kyouji asked for his help to give him her love letter.

While Haruya was giving the love letter to Kyouji, the latter misunderstood Haruya's intentions and he then got caught up in the misunderstanding and now, they're dating!?
